'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
****The [[UN Security Council]] holds an open debate, with many of the nearly 90 countries on the speakers' list calling for a [[ceasefire]] amid the increasing death toll in Gaza. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/25/us-resists-ceasefire-call-in-un-security-council-debate-on-israel-gaza-war (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3239164/israel-bombards-southern-gaza-world-leaders-seek-pause-fighting (Reuters via ''SCMP'')]
****Draft resolutions calling for a ceasefire are being considered by both the UN Security Council and the [[UN General Assembly]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/cease-fire-or-pause-us-russia-poised-un-showdown-israel-2023-10-24/ (Reuters)]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****The [[Gaza Health Ministry]] announces that at least 704 people have died in the past day. The [[UNRWA|UN relief agency]] states this is "the highest fatality toll reported in a single day". [https://thehill.com/policy/international/4272805-704-dead-airstrikes-gaza-israel-hamas/ (The Hill)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/24/more-than-700-killed-in-overnight-israeli-attacks-gaza-officials-say (Al Jazeera)]
****At least 16 people are killed and several others are injured in [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s in areas including [[Jabalia]], [[Khan Yunis|Khan Younis]], and the [[Nuseirat Camp|Nuseirat refugee camp]]. [https://publisher.tbsnews.net/hamas-israel-war/un-chief-says-clear-violations-humanitarian-law-gaza-726138 (The Business Standard)]
***[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip|Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****In a televised address to the nation, [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] says that he has set the date for a ground invasion of the [[Gaza Strip]] with the main goals of the operation being to destroy [[Hamas]] and to rescue [[hostage]]s. [https://news.sky.com/story/israel-gaza-latest-hamas-militants-doomed-israeli-pm-says-in-tv-address-as-country-preparing-ground-offensive-12978800 (Sky News)]
***[[Israel]] bans [[United Nations]] officials from visiting the country after remarks on the conflict are made by [[Secretary-General of the United Nations|UN secretary-general]] [[António Guterres]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/israel-hamas-united-nations-gaza-b2435613.html (The Independent)] 
***At least 11 people are arrested in [[Hebron]] in the [[West Bank]] following an Israeli raid. Israeli troops stormed several villages including [[al-Burj, Hebron|al-Burj]] and [[Majd al-Krum|al-Majd]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/24/israel-hamas-war-live-fuel-shortfall-could-force-un-to-halt-work-in-gaza-2 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] launches airstrikes on "military infrastructure" of the [[Syrian Armed Forces]] in [[Daraa Governorate]], killing eight [[Syria]]n soldiers and injuring seven others. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-strikes-syria-after-rocket-attack-on-north-8-syrian-soldiers-said-killed/ (The Times of Israel)] 

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023 United Auto Workers strike]]
**[[Ford Motor Company|Ford]] reaches a deal with the [[United Auto Workers]], signaling an end to the strike after 41 days. [https://www.nbcnews.com/business/business-news/uaw-reaches-deal-ford-signaling-end-to-strike-whats-next-rcna122181 (NBC News)]
*[[Credit rating]] agency [[S&P Global Ratings|S&P]] says that it is downgrading [[Israel]]'s rating outlook to "negative" to reflect "the risk that the [[Israel–Hamas war]] could spread more widely". [[Fitch Ratings]] also places a similar negative rating on Israel. [https://www.straitstimes.com/business/sp-lowers-israel-s-rating-outlook-to-negative-on-war-risks (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Otis]] becomes the most intense landfalling [[cyclone]] in the Eastern [[Pacific]] basin on record after making landfall near [[Acapulco]], [[Mexico]], and killing at least 27 people in the city, as a category 5 [[hurricane]] with 1-minute sustained winds of {{convert|165|mph|km/h}}. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-hurricane-otis-acapulco-17b4b34147a2fe5acbe980a0b5b06aa7 (AP)]
*Two people are killed, and more than five buildings are destroyed, as more than forty out-of-control [[bushfire]]s continue to burn in the [[Darling Downs]] in [[Queensland]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-10-25/qld-bushfires-body-found-tara-millmerran/103015702 (ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2020–2023 H5N1 outbreak]]
**[[Brazil]] reports the deaths of 522 [[Pinniped|seals]] along the coast of [[Rio Grande do Sul]], attributing the cause to [[avian flu]]. [https://phys.org/news/2023-10-bird-flu-marine-mammals-brazil.html (AFP via Phys.org)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] calls for an immediate ceasefire in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], and says that [[Hamas]] is "not a terrorist organization, it is a liberation group, [[mujahideen]] waging a battle to protect its lands and people". [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/10/25/Turkey-s-Erdogan-says-Hamas-is-not-a-terrorist-organization- (Reuters via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Russia and weapons of mass destruction]]
**The [[Russian Federation Council]] unanimously approves the [[State Duma]]'s bill to revoke Russia's membership in the [[Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/25/russia-simulates-nuclear-strike-after-opting-out-of-treaty (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Violent incidents in reaction to the Israel–Hamas war]]
***A man is charged with hate crimes after being accused of pepper spraying pro-[[State of Palestine|Palestine]] [[Israel–Hamas war protests|protesters]] that gathered near an [[Israel]] solidarity event at a banquet hall in northern [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], [[United States|U.S]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-illinois-protest-hate-crimes-698b1c9dc575eb736ac2e88544641a7a (AP)]
***US legal organization [[Palestine Legal]] says it has responded to more than 260 requests for assistance in the past two weeks, ranging from job losses to the cancellation of classes. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/24/israel-hamas-war-live-fuel-shortfall-could-force-un-to-halt-work-in-gaza-2 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Lewiston shootings]]
**[[Mass shooting|Multiple shootings]] in [[Lewiston, Maine]], [[United States]], leave at least 18 people dead and dozens more injured. The suspected gunman remains at large. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/25/us/lewiston-maine-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

*[[LGBT rights in Japan]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Japan]] rules that [[compulsory sterilization|requiring sterilization]] as part of [[gender transition]]ing is [[Constitution of Japan|unconstitutional]], but sends its ruling on the [[gender-affirming surgery]] requirement back to a lower court. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20231025-japan-court-says-gender-change-sterilisation-rule-unconstitutional (AFP via RFI)]
*[[Chief Executive of Hong Kong|Hong Kong Chief Executive]] [[John Lee Ka-chiu|John Lee]] announces plans for [[Hong Kong]] to formulate [[Hong Kong Basic Law Article 23|its own national security law]] by 2024. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231025-hong-kong-s-leader-says-to-create-new-national-security-law-in-2024 (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Surrey Police]] arrest British [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative]] [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MP]] [[Crispin Blunt]] on suspicion of [[Sexual offences in English law|rape]] and possession of [[Controlled Drug in the United Kingdom|controlled substances]], but is later released on conditional bail. The Conservative Party has suspended Blunt, who continues to sit in the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]] as an [[Independent politician|independent MP]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/uk/british-mp-arrested-on-suspicion-of-rape/articleshow/104736854.cms (AFP via ''TOI'')]

'''Politics and elections'''

**[[United States Republican Party|Republican]] [[Mike Johnson (Louisiana politician)|Mike Johnson]] is elected [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|Speaker]] of the [[U.S. House of Representatives]]. [https://apnews.com/article/house-speaker-republicans-emmer-mccarthy-54352a64be041cd445bda8df28b24f03 (AP)]
